body.name: rank-at-most-three ambient compression
body.construction: Choose \(q\geq1\), \(1\leq k\leq\min(q,3)\), and full-row-rank \(B\in\mathbb R^{k\times q}\). For a polynomial \(\bar D\) on \(\operatorname{Sym}_k(\mathbb R)\), set \(D_B(A)=\bar D(BAB^{\top})\) on \(Sq\). Set \(R_k=(I_k\;0)\in\mathbb Q^{k\times3}\) and \(\widetilde D(X)=\bar D(R_kXR_k^{\top})\) on \(S3\).
